observed.attributionRationale: The March 31, 2026 SEC investment schedule for Partners Group Next Generation Infrastructure, LLC identifies Exus US Holdings, LP as a direct-equity investment acquired October 3, 2023. Name that one disclosed participating fund instead of treating the holding partnership as a fund; the remaining Partners Group client allocations are not publicly disclosed. Preserve the legal vehicle, unknown stake, 2023 entry and null curated fund link.

Partners Group's October 4, 2023 transaction announcement expressly invests alongside Exus founders and management. Their retained equity is a direct ownership interest, not an unresolved investment fund. Preserve the existing retained/rolled vehicle, unknown stake and original entry year; do not infer a minority percentage or manager fund.
